# Linearity

> Linearity is a comprehensive design and animation platform offering vector design (Curve) and motion graphics (Move) tools for Mac, iPad, and iPhone with AI-assisted editing, collaboration features, and extensive template libraries.

Linearity provides professional-grade design and animation software optimized for Apple devices, enabling designers and creators to build brand assets, illustrations, logos, and animated content. The platform includes learning resources through Linearity Academy and offers flexible pricing tiers including a Figma plugin integration.

## Key Topics

- Linearity Curve
- Linearity Move

## Core Products

- [Linearity Home](https://www.linearity.io): Homepage showcasing Curve and Move design & animation apps for Apple devices
- [Curve: Advanced Vector Design Software](https://www.linearity.io/curve): Vector design app featuring AI editing, collaboration, and professional design tools for Mac, iPad, and iPhone
- [Move: Intuitive Motion Design App](https://www.linearity.io/move): Animation and motion graphics app with keyframes, shape morphing, and timeline controls for iPad and macOS

## Getting Started & Pricing

- [Download Linearity](https://www.linearity.io/get-started): Download page for Linearity Curve and Move from App Store

- [Pricing Plans](https://www.linearity.io/pricing): Subscription tiers for Curve, Move, and Figma plugin with flexible pricing options

## Use Cases & Industry Solutions

- [Digital Illustration](https://www.linearity.io/use-cases/digital-illustration): Digital illustration capabilities and workflows with Linearity Curve
- [Logo Design](https://www.linearity.io/use-cases/logos): Logo design with Curve and animation with Move for brand identity
- [Branding](https://www.linearity.io/use-cases/branding): Brand asset creation and branding workflows using Curve and Move
- [Ad Campaign Design & Animation](https://www.linearity.io/use-cases/ad-campaign): Designing and animating digital ads with ROI-focused marketing content
- [Social Media Design](https://www.linearity.io/use-cases/social-media-design): Social media content creation and animation suite for Instagram, Facebook, and other platforms
- [Poster Design](https://www.linearity.io/use-cases/posters): Poster design with free templates for business and event promotion
